svg.text: The rival: close-up face set, glasses clear and glare (approved by Orb)
Eight expressions with frame C clear (eyes dimly visible) and with the glare on (eyes fully hidden, the mouth carries the face), at 200 px, and the damage stages. No mask. Pending Legal review.
Damage stages with the glare on, neutral: fresh, scuffed, torn, ruined (frame C bends, a lens cracks and a shard goes from a corner; the eyes stay covered)

Signature: the contempt, and the smirk under the glare. With the glare on the eyes are gone, so the mouth and the head tilt are the whole expression: keep those strong. A cracked lens and glasses knocked off are allowed by Legal
